title: Regulations regarding goods imported or to be exported by** **[1][post or courier]
text:
84. Regulations regarding goods imported or to be exported by [post or courier].—The Board

may make regulations providing for—

3[(a) the form and manner in which an entry may be made in respect of goods imported or to be

exported by [post or courier];]

(b) the examination, assessment to duty, and clearance of goods imported or to be exported by

1[post or courier];

(c) the transit or transhipment of goods imported by [post or courier], from one customs station to

another or to a place outside India.

_Stores_
